classification.source_level_rationale: The record is a verbatim transcript of a live parliamentary session, created at the time of the debate by the National Council.
classification.resume: This is a parliamentary question session recording from the Swiss National Council (Nationalrat) on 23 September 1985, covering a wide range of topics including Swiss passports, European social charter, South African debt settlement and Switzerland's stance, environmental issues, ski championships, forestry, waste disposal, cultural funding, nuclear power, civil protection, asylum law, ecclesiastical structures, cross-border taxation, and a multi-departmental working group on women's participation in defense.
